def _mapped(q, fitted):
    (scale, power, exponent) = fitted['p']
    logabs = np.log(np.maximum(np.abs(q), np.finfo(float).tiny))
    h = q * np.exp(exponent * np.logaddexp(0, power * (np.log(scale) + logabs)))
    return np.c_[np.ones(len(q)), q, h] @ fitted['w']

def run_node(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    study = inputs['__input__']
    fitted = inputs['node_00']
    train = study['train']
    n = len(train['x'])
    q = _calibrate(study['panel_a'], np.vstack((train['x'], study['test']['x'])), fitted)
    b = _mapped(q, fitted)
    c = b * np.roll(q, -1, axis=1)
    y = _scalar(q, b, c, np.asarray(train['y']), float(study['telemetry_vec'][2]))
    design = np.c_[np.ones(len(q)), b, c]
    state = design[n:] @ _ls(design[:n], train['traj'])
    last = state[:, -1]
    return {'y_hat': y, 'state_pred': state, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), last.mean(), last.std()])}

def solve_batch(study: dict) -> dict:
    train = study['train']
    (a, q) = _design(train['x'])
    (a_test, q_test) = _design(study['test']['x'])
    readout = np.linalg.lstsq(q, train['y'], rcond=None)[0]
    y = q_test @ readout
    state_coef = np.linalg.lstsq(a, train['traj'], rcond=None)[0]
    (_, _, modes) = np.linalg.svd(a @ state_coef, full_matrices=False)
    basis = modes[:2].T
    state = a_test @ state_coef @ basis @ basis.T
    final = state[:, -1]
    diagnostics = np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), final.mean(), final.std()])
    return {'y_hat': y, 'state_pred': state, 'diagnostics_vec': diagnostics}
